summary: --deliver webhook:<url> must be governed by --timeout, using a context minted at the call site rather than the command's own (already-cancelled) context.
reason: Delivery runs after rootCmd.Execute() returns, so the command context is dead by then and cannot be inherited; the generated code sidestepped that by building the request with http.NewRequest under a hardcoded 30s client deadline, which silently ignored --timeout and could block a caller for the full 30s after its deadline had passed. A regen that reaches for the command context here will abort every delivery instead.
validated_outcome: TestDeliverWebhookHonorsContext fails at 30.03s against the pre-fix code (the hardcoded client deadline) and passes in 0.10s after.
